KONAMI PRE-GX

This folder is reserved for compatible Arcade content.
Compatible released Coin-Op content may be placed here manually.
Obtain files from an authorized source. Required Arcade cores belong in _Arcade/cores/; follow the source instructions.
DownloaderPLUS does not provide ROMs or currently distribute this system's payloads.
This location may become automatically managed when an approved authoritative public distribution is available.
